title: Blissful Ackee Fritters
description: A delicious and crispy keto snack made with ackee, umami, and bliss. Perfect for a quick pick-me-up.
instructions: 1. In a bowl, mix together ackee, umami paste, bliss seeds, coconut flour, eggs, shredded coconut, salt, and black pepper.
2. Heat a non-stick pan with a small amount of oil over medium heat.
3. Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the ackee mixture into the pan.
4. Flatten the mixture slightly with a spatula to form patties.
5. Cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
